text: Okay, so I wanna know how many t-shirt options there are right now in the online store. And I have some pending t-shirts I want to modify. I want to change them all to purple, size small, same v-neck style, and prefer polyester material. Can you tell me if that's possible and how many options I've got?
zh: 好的，所以我想知道在线商店目前有多少种T恤选项。我有一些待处理的T恤想要修改。我想把它们全部改为紫色、小号、相同的V领样式，并偏好涤纶材质。你能告诉我这是否可行，以及我有哪些选项吗？
